title: Bahahi ba Litšiea Tse Phahameng
intro: U eme ka pel'a lithako tsa motse o moholo oa boholo-holo, litšiea tsa oona tse telele li se li oele. Moea o foka ka har'a literateng tse se nang letho, o jere mohopolo oa batho ba matla ba kileng ba busa linaha tsena. E ne e le bo-mang?
clues: Re ne re le batho ba matla le bokgoni bo boholo, re tsebahala ka meaho ya rona e meholo le tsoelo-pele e tswetseng pele.
Re ne re lula naheng ea litutulu tsa lehlabathe le maralla a majoe, 'me re ne re lumela hore ha ho motho ea ka re hlōlang.
Moromuoa o tlile ho rona a tsoa har'a beng ka rona, a re bitsa ho rapela Allah a le mong, empa ra mo hana 'me ra mo soma.
Re ile ra ithorisa ra re, ‘Ke mang ea matla ho re feta?’ ’me ra tsoela pele ka boikhohomoso ba rōna le borapeli ba litšoantšo.
Allah o ile a re romela moea o matla o ileng oa foka masiu a supileng le matsatsi a robeli, oa senya ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
Re ne re le batho ba 'Ad, ba hahileng Iram, 'me qetello ea rona e ile ea fetoha temoso ho bohle ba ileng ba tla ka mor'a eona.

trial.label: Kotlo e ile ea romelloa ho bona e ne e le efe?

location.label: Lebitso la motse oa bona o tummeng ke mang?

outcome.label: Qetello ea bona e bile efe?
options: Li ile tsa timetsoa 'me masala a tsona a fetoha thuto
Ba ile ba baka 'me ba pholosoa
Ba ile ba khangoa ke metsi leoatleng
Ba ile ba patoa tlas'a mobu o thellang
outcome.answer: Li ile tsa timetsoa 'me masala a tsona a fetoha thuto

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
